enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Tendon Slice +6: On Hit: 6% chance to slow target's movement by 50% for 6 seconds.
Electrifying 4: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to arc with electricity, dealing 4d6 Lightning damage on each hit.
Freezing 9: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to become frozen to the touch, dealing 9 to 54 Ice damage on each critical hit.
Armor-Piercing 12%: Passive: +12% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
